description: Vijay promised corruption-free welfare delivery powered by artificial intelligence, introducing a "priority card" system similar to Aadhaar to ensure benefits reach citizens automatically without applications or bribes. He proposed a unified digital platform—"Vetri Tamil Nadu Super App"—
body_lead: Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) president Vijay on Sunday outlined an ambitious governance roadmap while sharply criticising Chief Minister M. K. Stalin during an election campaign in Kanyakumari district. Addressing a gathering in Mahadhanapuram, Vijay promised a corruption-free delivery of welfare schemes, asserting that benefits would reach citizens without the need for applications or bribes. He announced that every family in Tamil Nadu would be issued a "priority card," similar to Aadhaar, containing comprehensive household data.
